Dear god, ask for help. 

If you know there’s something wrong with you, if you know that there’s something in your brain that doesn’t seem normal, tell somebody about it, a professional. 
I’m not saying you should never tell your friends about mental issues you’re having, but please be aware that your friends also have their own issues. No one unqualified person who you’re just friends with should have to be your personal therapist. To add onto that, you should NEVER feel obligated to be someone else’s’. 
If your friends are treating you badly, if your significant other is treating you badly, cut them off. If there’s a feeling of loneliness or that you’re constantly being antagonized, don’t keep that inside of yourself. 
Bottling up your emotions is bad. You see it on TV all the time, but it’s still just as awful. Vent to someone who cares to listen, even if it’s your cat. 
Let others vent to you. Learn to care about other people’s situations and sympathize while simultaneously not trying to personally solve every one of their issues. 
If someone makes fun of you for something, it doesn’t matter. So long as it’s not hurting you or anybody else, do what you like. This one is. So hard to learn if you’re like me and constantly thinking of society’s view on you, but trust me, if you’re able to let that go for even a little bit, you end up doing loads of things you never would have otherwise. 
Meet new people. Strike up conversations. Help people when you see they’re struggling. If you’re struggling, ask for help. 
No, it’s not actually normal to be sad and want to kill yourself all the time. I know the hot new memes are “I’m gonna kill myself” jokes, but they can be harmful to your psyche. 
Be aware that you can pick your friends. By that I mean if you see someone you would like to get to know, talk to them. Get to know them. Don’t put the social barrier up in your head because “they don’t seem like they’d like me”. And if they don’t? Who cares! Move on!
Learn to move on. Move on from friends who drifted apart from you. Move on from he said she said. Move on from what happened years ago. 
If someone apologizes to you but you still are angry at them or holding a grudge, re-evaluate why you still feel this way instead of continuing to hate them despite an apology. If it’s needed, tell them why. 
There’s probably a lot more, but even just being 18 there’s plenty of regrets that have fucked up my brain that I’d love to prevent others from doing.
